title: Preboard ZIP + Seat Setup Slate
body:
Context and intent:
This is a lightweight, operational preboard + seat setup slate for IC hires who need speed (fast-embed) or hybrid seating. It bundles (1) what people-ops must trigger before day 0, (2) desk/hardware logistics we send to vendors, (3) quick ergonomics + security checks for site/on-prem seats, and (4) a minimal day-1 checklist for managers and buddies.

Goals:
- Move from 'offer accepted' to 'first productive hour' by streamlining seat + tooling setup.
- Avoid back-and-forth: single doc to drive vendor SKUs, local facilities, IT imaging, and manager expectations.
- Capture a repeatable fallback flow when shipping lead times > 5 business days.

Quick notes / constraints (working assumptions):
- Target roles: IC (engineering, infra, SRE), PMs, product infra. For people requiring specialized gear (GPU dev kits, secure HSM laptops) use separate order flow.
- Shipping lead times: standard laptop 2–4 business days (domestic), monitor + arm 5–8. International varies.
- Security: all corporate laptops must have disk encryption and corporate VPN pre-configured by imaging team before handoff. If not possible, manager must schedule a 30-min session on day 0.

Preboard triggers (owner: people-ops ops lead) — timeline semantics (D = day offer accepted):
- D+0 (immediate): Create hire packet in HRIS, tag location, hire type (remote/hybrid/on-prem). Notify IT & Facilities via ticket with "preboard-zip" template.
- D+1: Confirm primary workstation choice with candidate (options: MacBook Pro 14, MacBook Pro 16, Linux laptop, Windows). Confirm monitor preference (none / one 27" / two 27").
- D+1: Reserve shipping window and select vendor SKU from vendor master. Attach SKU and shipping address to ticket.
- D+2–D+4: Imaging queue — assign imaging slot; add required corp certs and VPN; add GitHub + internal repo access group tags (approx list below).
- D-1 (one day before start): Confirm last-mile courier and expected delivery window; send calendar invite for pickup/hand-off to on-site coordinator if hybrid.

Vendor SKU quick-reference (for vendor ops):
- SKU-LTP-14MBP: 14" MacBook Pro, 16GB, 1TB — ship with USB-C dock, power, USB-C to Ethernet dongle.
- SKU-LTP-16MBP: 16" MacBook Pro, 32GB, 1TB — included for senior ICs.
- SKU-MON-27-ARM: 27" monitor + articulating arm + VESA mount.
- SKU-DOCK-UC: USB-C dock with Ethernet + 2x 10GbE passthrough for infra engineers.
- Note: include spare power adapter in parcel for international shipments.

Imaging / IT handoff checklist (owner: IT imaging team) — pre-day 0 actions:
- Build image with latest corporate baseline (ossec, disk encryption, endpoint manager).
- Pre-install: Slack, Zoom, Chrome/Firefox, corporate SSO agent, endpoint monitoring, VPN config, corporate password manager client.
- Create local admin account per policy and add to SSO group.
- Invite to GitHub org and add to repo groups requested in the ticket (list expected: repo-core, infra-shared, deployment-access).
- Add MFA enforcement and register device with corporate MDM.
- Add device tag with hire ID and shipping tracking URL in asset DB.

Facilities / desk setup (owner: facilities ops) — if in-office or hybrid:
- Reserve desk for first 2 weeks (hot-desk or assigned) and add note about ergonomic kit if requested.
- Ergonomic kit options: monitor arm, laptop stand, external keyboard & mouse.
- Badge provisioning: coordinate with security to have building access activated on day 0.
- Local point-of-contact: facilities-champion (listed on ticket).

Security & compliance quick items (owner: security):
- Ensure new hire completes security acknowledgement (link in welcome email) before first day.
- If role is high-sensitivity, schedule an onboarding compliance call day 1.
- Confirm whether KMS/HSM access is required and whether PI data access needs approval from DPO.

Manager & buddy checklist (owner: hiring manager):
- Pre-day 0: Send welcome note with agenda for day 1 and any reading (team handbook, design docs).
- Day 0 AM: Meet for 30 minutes — quick intro, role expectations, 7-day priorities.
- Assign a buddy for first 14 days; buddy must have a 30-min slot reserved every morning for first week.
- Confirm dev environment pairing session on day 1 afternoon (account creation + sample PR run).

Day-by-day minimal cadence (fast-embed path):
- Day 0: Device arrives or pickup; imaging checklist sign-off by IT; manager 30-min sync; buddy intro.
- Day 1: Access to repos + internal tooling validated; sample task assigned (tiny onboarding ticket).
- Day 2-3: Pairing on first ticket; evidence of PR + CI pass expected by EOD day 3 for fast-embed hires.
- Day 7: First-week check-in (manager + people-ops triage for any blockers).
- Day 14: 14-day ramp recap and light eval (are tools/policies working).

Fallbacks & late-ships (practical):
- If laptop shipping > 5 business days: use local loaner program. Process: manager requests loaner in ticket; IT images generic loaner image and creates temporary SSO token with 7-day expiry.
- For international hires with customs hold risk: offer remote-first start (no local desk) and ensure access to cloud dev environment (CloudIDE) with identical access groups.

Open questions / decisions to resolve (notes to self):
- Should we expand SKU list for Linux/ARM dev kits (ask infra leads Marcus & Lina)?
- Decide whether to include a physical welcome pack (swag + culture card) for remote hires — cost analysis needed.
- Clarify whether external monitor warranty should be handled by vendor or facilities for replacements under 2 years.

Random operational snippets (things to remember):
- Always add "preboard-zip" tag to HRIS hire packet to avoid duplication.
- Slack welcome flow: new-hire-bot should DM with onboarding links and Calendly for buddy slot.
- Use standardized subject line for vendor emails: "[Preboard ZIP] <hire-name> | <start-date> | <SKU>"

Mini templates (copy/paste):
- Vendor email subject: [Preboard ZIP] Priya Nambiar | 2025-07-28 | SKU-LTP-14MBP
- Manager day-0 invite body: Quick agenda: 1) Team + context (10m) 2) Role expectations + 7-day goals (10m) 3) Access check + dev env pairing (10m)

References / links (work-in-progress):
- Confluence preboard playbook: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/PE/Preboard+Playbook
- Imaging runbook (internal): HR-3127
- Vendor master SKU list: vendor://catalog/sku-master (ask procurement for read link)

Last notes (TODOs):
- Follow up with procurement on adding SKU-DOCK-UC to preferred vendor list (action: Priya, due 2025-07-10).
- Validate loaner pool count for Q3 hiring surge (action: Marcus, due 2025-07-11).
- Run a dry-run with new-hire bot + buddy DM flow on 2025-07-15 (action: Ethan).

This doc is intentionally compact. Use it as the operational single-source for fast-embed hires; copy into offer-acceptance workflow and attach to HR ticket. Keep edits here simple (date + initials) so we can iterate quickly.

-- Priya N. (people-ops)
